title: Generate, Discriminate, Evolve: Enhancing Context Faithfulness via Fine-Grained Sentence-Level Self-Evolution
authors: Kun Li; Tianhua Zhang; Yunxiang Li; Hongyin Luo; Abdalla Moustafa; Xixin Wu; James Glass; Helen Meng
why_relevant: Proposes a self-evolving framework to enhance context faithfulness in RAG, directly addressing knowledge conflicts between parametric memory and retrieved evidence via sentence-level optimization.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on faithfulness training rather than broader robustness; evaluated only on ASQA/ConFiQA.
